promises.credibility: Operational milestones (exports, hydroquinone ramp) do land, but plant dates slip by quarters and the margin-improvement promise has not shown up in the reported numbers yet.

bull: Back to growth: Sep-26 quarter sales ₹299 Cr, +22% YoY, after −9% and −5% in Dec-25 and Mar-26.
Net-cash balance sheet: borrowings ₹2 Cr vs investments ₹397 Cr; management calls current capex 'largely funded'.
Operating leverage queued: hydroquinone utilisation 30–35% targeted at 55–60%; HALS capacity rising to ~12,500 t.
bear: Margins sliding: quarterly OPM 31% in Sep-26 vs 41% in Jun-25; annual OPM 42% (FY24) → 34% (TTM).
Profit not following sales: Sep-26 PAT ₹56 Cr vs ₹55 Cr a year ago on +22% revenue.
Execution slippage: PC2 start moved from May–Jun to Nov–Dec 2026; PC1 revenue potential cut to ₹260 Cr from ₹320 Cr.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: Two consecutive quarters of OPM ≥ 36% with advanced-grade HALS above 40% of the mix.
